About.heading: About Me
About.bio:
I'm an IT Support Technician with over six years of experience in the technology world. My background spans from hardware repair and maintenance to enterprise software development, giving me a unique perspective: I understand both hardware and software, both the cable and the code.

I offer comprehensive IT support services: PC and laptop repair and maintenance, operating system installation and configuration, malware removal, performance optimization, data backup and recovery, network and printer configuration, and remote support to solve problems without the need for on-site visits.

What sets me apart from a traditional technician is my background as a software developer. This means I don't just fix computers: I can create custom automations, integrate systems, develop tools that optimize your processes, and provide IT consulting with a real understanding of how the software running on your machines works. For businesses and SMEs, this translates into a more complete and strategic service.

I work remotely and on-site depending on the need. I believe in a close, transparent service focused on solving the root problem — not just the symptom. If you need reliable IT support, with the guarantee of someone who understands technology end to end, I'm here to help.

ProfessionalProfile.heading: Professional Profile
ProfessionalProfile.summary:
I'm an IT Support Technician with over six years of experience in the IT world. My training as a Computer Science Technologist and my background as a software developer give me a unique perspective: I don't just fix computers, I understand how every layer of technology works.

I offer comprehensive IT support services for businesses and individuals:

• PC and laptop repair and maintenance — hardware diagnosis, component replacement, troubleshooting.
• Windows and operating system installation and configuration — formatting, drivers, optimization.
• Malware, virus, and spyware removal — deep cleaning and protection.
• Performance optimization — RAM and SSD upgrades, system tuning.
• Data backup and recovery — critical information protection.
• Network, WiFi, router, and printer configuration.
• Remote support — fast resolution without on-site visits.
• IT consulting for businesses — preventive maintenance, technology planning.

My key differentiator: I'm a software developer. This means I can create custom automations, scripts that eliminate repetitive tasks, personalized tools, and system integrations — something no traditional technician can offer. For an SME, this translates into real efficiency and a much more complete service.

I work with seriousness, transparency, and commitment. Every service includes clear diagnosis, a budget with no surprises, and post-work follow-up. If you're looking for quality IT support, from someone who truly understands technology end to end, I'm here to help.
